[SWS_DM_00163] Definition of a inhibited clear operation on single DTC
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04180
⌈
If it is requested to clear a single DTC and a
DiagnosticClearCondition
ref-
erenced from this DTC (via
DiagnosticTroubleCodeUdsToClearCondition-
GroupMapping
) is not fulfilled, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall send a
negative response 0x22 (
kConditionsNotCorrect
).
⌋
